verdict.rationale: Shopify documents the full agent purchase chain: create_checkout from a cart, complete_checkout ("Submit payment and place the order") once a payment credential is collected, and post-purchase order state via get_order and order webhooks. However, direct completion is restricted to Token-tier "trusted agents" whose token is granted purchase permission, and the default documented path hands the buyer off to the merchant storefront via continue_url for payment. Delegated payment credentials appear only as negotiated payment_handlers (e.g., com.google.pay) and as AP2 mandates in the UCP spec. missing for 10: generally available direct checkout completion without trusted-tier gating, Shopify-specific documentation of how a delegated payment credential is minted and passed, hands-on verification beyond cart creation (no checkout or payment probed), self-serve order webhook registration.
